svg.title: HTML email: the old dialect
svg.desc: Email clients render a 2005 dialect of HTML: tables for layout, inline styles, no scripts, no forms.
svg.text: Gmail and Outlook sanitize aggressively: your modern CSS and semantic tags may simply vanish.
table layouts · inline style attributes · gif/jpg images · system fonts
<script> · <form> · position/float · web fonts · external CSS files
<table role="presentation" width="600"> <!-- the accepted email skeleton -->
role="presentation" tells screen readers to skip table semantics you are only using for layout.
Test with Litmus or Email on Acid previews — or accept plain-text-first design and simpler maintenance.
